name: Mitten Extracts 510 Cartridge | Sour Diesel
description: This sativa-dominant hybrid is best known for its strong diesel-like smell. This legendary strain will put the consumer in an energized dream-like state. While indulging, one may start to notice the fading of life's physical and mental stressors. It acts as a great tool to help combat depression and more. This strain is believed to have descended from Chemdog 91 and Super Skunk.
